name: No-Sugar-Added Coconut Tapioca Pudding with Berry Compote (Night 1)
whyItWorks: Dairy-free coconut milk and soft tapioca pearls are gentle, though the berry topping and possible lime zest garnish require scraping off.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the white coconut tapioca base only, scraping off any seeded berry compote or lime zest on top.
watchOuts: Berry seeds and possible lime zest garnish on top
